categories.label: Leveraged staking

categories.scope: Staked ETH looped against borrowed ETH on lending markets, private and product.

categories.measurement: Products counted once: staking tokens held inside other products or posted in lending markets are counted where they are used (lending markets: leveraged staking, carry products, money markets).

categories.label: Carry
